data.text:
DPWH, PINAIIGTING ANG OPLAN KONTRA BAHA BAGO ANG TAG-ULAN 

PANOORIN: Patuloy ang malawakang hakbang ng Department of Public Works and Highways o DPWH sa paghahanda laban sa inaasahang pagdating ng tag-ulan.

Sa ilalim ng Oplan Kontra Baha, tuluy-tuloy ang ginagawang dredging, desilting, at paglilinis ng mga pangunahing waterways sa iba’t ibang panig ng bansa.

Ayon sa Department of Public Works and Highways, bahagi ito ng direktiba ng Pangulo na tiyaking maayos ang daluyan ng tubig upang maiwasan ang matinding pagbaha.

Tiniyak naman ni Secretary Vince Dizon na pinalalawak pa ang operasyon ng Oplan Kontra Baha na nakatuon sa mga lugar na madalas tamaan ng baha tulad ng Metro Manila, Ilocos Region, Cagayan Valley, Naga, Cebu, Bacolod, Cagayan de Oro, at Maguindanao.

Layunin ng programa na mapababa ang risko ng pagbaha at maprotektahan ang mga komunidad sa panahon ng tag-ulan. | RH 29 @boy_gonzales, DZRH News

Courtesy: DPWH

As #Iranian and #American delegations would be arriving in #Pakistan for historic PEACE negotiations, the Islamabad police has announced measures to ensure security. The @ICT_Police  is issued the following Traffic Advisory for the main Srinagar Highway. 

“Diversions will be implemented on Srinagar Highway due to the movement of foreign delegations.

Citizens are requested to plan their travel with extra time during this period.

Islamabad Traffic Police is present on the roads for the convenience and awareness of the public.

Citizens are urged to exercise patience and cooperate with Islamabad Traffic Police during this time.

Citizens can also obtain further information from the Islamabad Traffic Police's WhatsApp channel and social media pages.”

IN PHOTOS: An oil tanker carrying 12,000 liters of fuel was removed from a residential area in Barangay Sacred Heart, Quezon City, following an order from the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) due to the absence of a required installation permit. The tanker, discovered last Saturday, had raised safety concerns among residents. Authorities from the Philippine National Police (PNP) are conducting a case build-up and may file criminal charges against the owner and the fuel supplier. 

📸: Manny Palmero
